property_summary: After a successful initialize(accessControl) on a properly-initializable instance of C, any subsequent access-checked call (setSlopes with valid slopes) must succeed because the stored access control grants access; the mutant never stores accessControl (it stays address(0)), so setSlopes always fails.
change_summary: Remove the call to __Access_init so accessControl is never set, making subsequent access checks target address(0).
